concepts.common_confusion_amharic: [አማርኛ] ተማሪዎች ይህንን ጽንሰ-ሐሳብ ከሌሎች ተዛማጅ ርዕሶች ጋር ሊያደናግሩ ይችላሉ።

concepts.simple_definition: 2.2 Perfect Competition Market Grade 11 Economics Student Textbook 38 As it is shown in Figure 2.1 (A) the demand curve for perfectly competitive market is downward-sloping
concepts.deep_explanation: As shown in Figure 2.3, the demand (DD) curve for an individual firm is horizontal and equals to the equilibrium price (P) of the market or average revenue (AR) and to the marginal revenue (MR) of the firm
concepts.real_example: Practical example of 2.2 Perfect Competition Market Grade 11  from page 49.
concepts.common_confusion: Students sometimes confuse 2.2 Perfect Competition Market Grade 11  with adjacent topics in Chapter 2.
concepts.simple_definition_amharic: [አማርኛ] 2.2 Perfect Competition Market Grade 11 Economics Student Textbook 38 As it is shown in Figure 2.1 (A) the demand curve for perfectly competitive market is downward-sloping (ይህ ትርጓሜ በኢትዮጵያ የ11ኛ ክፍል ሥርዓተ-ትምህርት መሠረት የተዘጋጀ ነው)።
concepts.deep_explanation_amharic: [አማርኛ ማብራሪያ] As shown in Figure 2.3, the demand (DD) curve for an individual firm is horizontal and equals to the equilibrium price (P) of the market or average revenue (AR) and to the marginal revenue (MR) of the firm — ይህ ጽንሰ-ሐሳብ ተማሪዎች በክፍል ውስጥ የተማሩትን በቀላሉ እንዲረዱ ይረዳቸዋል።

concepts.common_confusion_amharic: [አማርኛ] ተማሪዎች ይህንን ጽንሰ-ሐሳብ ከሌሎች ተዛማጅ ርዕሶች ጋር ሊያደናግሩ ይችላሉ።
